description: Supplement hits show headline_nutrients and literal headline_lines in place of food macros; other_labels lists collapsed DSLD label ids accepted by get. Find entities by name (built for English; names a source publishes in another language, such as French, match as written), by barcode, or semantically. Filter by kind, brand, market. Returns compact hits with key nutrients; call get for full cards. The same food from several countries' sources (USDA, CIQUAL) is one result: the version for the market passed, else the best match, with the others under "variants"; each version carries only its own source's values. "match" is "confident" when the top result matched at least three quarters of your words; "none" means it did not, and the results that are shown are marked confidence "low" with the words they missed (unmatched): treat them as another food, not the answer. A misspelt word is corrected to a word our names use ("chiken" to chicken) when that matches more; "corrected" then shows the query as searched.

market.description: ISO 3166-1 country where the item is sold or eaten, e.g. US, GB, JP.

name: search
